title: Exact condensed coefficient changes and their derived tensor calculus
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], an algebraic closure $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying space is noetherian (every ascending chain of open subsets stabilizes). For finite intermediate fields $E\subseteq\Omega$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], put $E_T^c=p_T^*C(-,E)$ using [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Put $\Omega_T^c=p_T^*\underline\Omega$, where $\underline\Omega(S)$ consists of continuous functions on a profinite set $S$ with image in one finite intermediate field. Write $\mathcal C_T^c(E)$ for the full bounded constructible subcategory of $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{E_T^c})$ defined in [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]: cohomology vanishes outside a finite interval, and each cohomology sheaf has a finite locally closed stratification on whose strata it is pro-etale locally the cokernel of a map between finite rank free coefficient modules. Define $\mathcal C_T^c(\Omega)$ by the identical condition with coefficient ring $\Omega_T^c$. These are the master BoundedConstructible module-object categories, with no derived completeness condition. The adjunction below is on the ambient unbounded derived categories. For every finite $E\subseteq F\subseteq\Omega$, the underlying $E_T^c$-module of $F_T^c$ is finite free of rank $[F:E]$. For $B=F_T^c$ or $B=\Omega_T^c$, extension of scalars $B\otimes_{E_T^c}-$ on all module sheaves is exact and left adjoint to exact restriction of scalars $U_{B/E}$. Its derived functor is computed by termwise tensor on any representing complex, preserves distinguished triangles and shifts, and has the natural adjunction $$\operatorname{Hom}_{D(B)}(B\otimes_{E_T^c}^L K,L)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(E_T^c)}(K,U_{B/E}L).$$ For finite $E\subseteq F\subseteq G$ and also $G=\Omega$, tensor multiplication gives natural comparisons $$G_T^c\otimes_{F_T^c}^L(F_T^c\otimes_{E_T^c}^L K)\cong G_T^c\otimes_{E_T^c}^L K.$$ Together with the unit comparison for $E=F$, these satisfy the unit and pentagon identities and the analogous identities for shifts. Under restriction to $E_T^c$-modules, tensor commutes with the coefficient colimit: if $\Omega_T^c\cong\varinjlim_{F\supseteq E}F_T^c$, then $\varinjlim_{F\supseteq E}(F_T^c\otimes_{E_T^c}P)\cong\Omega_T^c\otimes_{E_T^c}P$ naturally for every module sheaf $P$.

proof.text: Choose the finite E-basis Module.finBasis E F, using restriction of scalars to prove finite dimensionality. Each basis coordinate is continuous by Mathlib LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional over Q_ell. Postcomposition on continuous functions defines actual module morphisms from C(-,F) to the finite direct sum of C(-,E), and basis vectors define the inverse. The basis reconstruction and coordinate identities prove the two inverse equations pointwise, including the ULift used in the presheaf of abelian groups.

For an additive monoidal functor L, mapModComapIso identifies transport of the restricted regular module with restriction of its transported regular module. mapBiproduct and the regular-module comparison transport the explicitly constructed finite free isomorphism. First apply this to presheafToSheaf, correcting the coefficient rings by sheafifyRingPresheafIso, and then to the existing exact strong monoidal upperStarFromPoint. This proves finite freeness on the scheme without the separate profinite_point_pullback theorem.

proof.text: Use the existing Compatibility.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_padicSubfieldRingObjMap and Compatibility.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl instances for flatness. Extension of scalars already preserves colimits as a left adjoint; scalar restriction preserves finite limits and colimits in the module-object API. Use Mod.extendRestrictAdjunction for both coefficient changes. The two source flatness declarations remain obligations of the source library, not new obligations in this delivery.

For each exact scalar extension f, use f.leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory and f.mapDerivedCategoryFactors. Whiskering the former with DerivedCategory.Q and composing gives the displayed termwise-complex factorization. The shift structure transported along the same comparison gives the displayed shift isomorphisms; isTriangulated_of_iso transfers triangulatedness from f.mapDerivedCategory.

The ambient derived adjunction is exactly Mod.derivedExtendMapDerivedCategoryAdjunction for the same coefficient map. Thus neither a new injective-resolution argument nor the generic ringed-topos adjunction statement is needed.

Identify extendScalarsComp followed by extendScalarsIsoOfEq with Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso for the scalar-restriction comparisons. Their associativity and unit identities follow from Mathlib leftAdjointCompIso_assoc and its unit laws: the restriction comparisons have identity underlying maps, so their coherence equations reduce to identity compositions. This checks the specified comparisons rather than choosing new ones.

The mapDerivedCategory composition constraints satisfy associativity and both unit laws by localization, and are natural under whiskering isomorphisms. Combine these with the underived scalar identities. Express each specified left-derived composition comparison as the corresponding mapDerivedCategory comparison conjugated by leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory. Naturality cancels the intervening conjugations and proves both associativity laws and all three unit laws. Compatibility of mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso with shifts, together with CommShift.ofIso_compatibility, gives both composition shift clauses. Prove the identity comparison shift-compatible by descending the identity comparison from complexes through the homotopy category and then the derived localization; this gives the remaining unit shift clause. The generic comparison and shift lemmas are proved as private helpers in this delivery. Their specialization to the eight concrete coefficient clauses remains the original named theorem condensedCoefficientCoherence with sorry. A full candidate passed standalone checking, but its artifact-producing compile exceeds 60 seconds; the remaining task is to simplify the resolution and shift interface and complete this specialization without changing the comparisons.
